title: A message from Elif
subtitle: An email to Izmir — writing about your life now
canDo: I can read a personal email.
I can write an email to a friend about my life now.
I can use at the moment and these days.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: e-posta yazma görevini ödev verin (Copy my text ile gönderilecek). Gerçek bir arkadaşa ya da aile üyesine yazmalarını önerin.
these days + present continuous (I'm working a lot these days) yeni bir kullanım. Tanıyıp kullanmaları yeterli, detaya girmeyin.
Arapçada büyük harf olmadığı için Arap öğrenciler i, zeynep gibi küçük harf hataları yapabilir. E-postalarda bunu özellikle kontrol edin.
Zeynep yeni bir karakter: Elif'in İzmir'deki en yakın arkadaşı, küçük bir erkek kardeşi var. Sesi İngiliz aksanlı.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Greetings from Boston!
sections.intro: An email from Elif to her best friend, Zeynep, in Izmir.
paragraphs: How are you? I hope you're well. Sorry for my late answer. I'm very busy these days!
At the moment, I'm sitting in the library near my school.
It's raining outside, and it's only nine degrees!
My life here is really good.
I go to class every morning, and on weekends I work at Sam's café.
Sam is very funny, and his dog, Biscuit, is always sleeping.
I'm wearing my new blue coat right now. It's very warm!
My neighbor, Mrs. Miller, is helping me a lot. She's like a grandmother to me.
What about you? What's your news?
What's the weather like in Izmir? I miss the sea and the sun … and your mom's cookies!

sections.title: Writing an email
look: **At the moment**, I**'m sitting** in the library.

head: Part
You can write …
rows: How are you? I hope you're well.
What about you? What's your news? Are you …?
Write back soon! / See you soon! **Love,** Elif

rules: Start with **Dear** or **Hi** + name and a comma (,).
**At the moment** / **right now** + am / is / are + -ing: At the moment, I'm sitting in the library.
**These days** + -ing for things happening around now: These days, I'm working a lot.
Names and **I** always start with a capital letter: **Z**eynep, **I**zmir, **I**'m.
examples: At the moment, I'm drinking coffee.
These days, I'm working a lot.

support.tr: İngilizce e-posta Dear (Sevgili) veya Hi + isim ve virgülle başlar. Şu anki haberlerini anlatırken at the moment (şu anda) ve these days (bu aralar) ile present continuous kullanılır: These days, I'm working a lot = Bu aralar çok çalışıyorum. Sonunda Write back soon! (Hemen cevap yaz!) ve Love, (Sevgiler,) + adın.
support.ar: تبدأ الرسالة الإلكترونية بـ Dear (عزيزي / عزيزتي) أو Hi + الاسم وفاصلة. وعند الحديث عن أخبارك الآن نستخدم at the moment (في هذه اللحظة) و these days (هذه الأيام) مع present continuous: These days, I'm working a lot = أعمل كثيرًا هذه الأيام. وفي النهاية نكتب Write back soon! (ردّ عليّ قريبًا!) ثم Love, (مع محبّتي) واسمك.

tr.note: İngilizcede I her zaman büyük harf; hitaptan sonra virgül koy.

ar.note: لا توجد حروف كبيرة في العربية، لكن في الإنجليزية نكتب الأسماء و I بحرف كبير.

sections.title: Write: An email to a friend

model.heading: To: Kareem
text: How are you and Hala? How is little Adam?
At the moment, I'm writing this at the hospital. It's a quiet night.
These days, I'm working a lot, but I'm happy.
It's cold and windy in Boston, so I wear my big coat every day.

sections.prompt: Write an email to a friend or a family member (7 to 9 sentences). Where are you? What's the weather like? What are you doing these days? Ask two questions.

support.tr: Bir arkadaşına ya da aile üyene e-posta yaz (7–9 cümle). Neredesin? Hava nasıl? Bu aralar neler yapıyorsun? İki soru sor.
support.ar: اكتب رسالة إلكترونية إلى صديق أو أحد أفراد عائلتك (7 إلى 9 جمل). أين أنت؟ كيف الطقس؟ ماذا تفعل هذه الأيام؟ اسأل سؤالين.

checklist: I start with Dear / Hi + name and a comma.
I use at the moment or these days + -ing.
I end with Write back soon! and my name.
